label: accepted

evidence.V1: Post with capped top and three rails reads as a fence segment in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view reads as cap plus rail line, fitting a tiling modular piece (T1 pass).
evidence.V2: Some hierarchy only: big post, medium rails, one small post cap; no secondary small detail (pegs, nails, grain notches) to give a third tier.
evidence.V3: Clean and well seated (no cross-shell overlaps) but forms are straight box primitives: an untapered post and three identical, evenly spaced, perfectly straight rails; only the overhanging cap adds character.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on cap, post and rail ends catch the light in the post-cap and rail-end close-ups.
evidence.V5: Clean smooth shading in post-cap, rail-end and rails close-ups; no seams, pinches or z-fighting.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one wood hue in two to three values (dark post, mid rails, light cap); colourways swap the hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 140 tris vs module target 800: far under target.
evidence.V8: One LF_VertexColor material, wood hue for a wood fence piece, kit-sized chamfers, 2-stud grid footprint; matches kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, grid-corner pivot, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic; all gates pass.
